title: Return window split by order date
summary: The policy change adds a 30-day window for orders from 2026-02-01 and keeps 14 days for earlier orders and the made-to-order exclusion.

judgments.before: 14 days from delivery for all orders
judgments.proposed: 30 days from delivery for orders placed from 2026-02-01
judgments.reason: The policy change meeting sets the new window and its start date.

judgments.proposed: Orders placed up to 2026-01-31 keep 14 days; the made-to-order exclusion stays for both
judgments.reason: Applying 30 days to every order would widen the change beyond what the source says.

judgments.before: The two documents are unrelated in the wiki
judgments.proposed: Update the existing policy page instead of marking a contradiction
judgments.reason: The windows differ by order date, so they do not conflict for the same order; Git keeps the old version.
